## Change

Describe the outcome and its governing RFC or documentation.

## Risk

- Classification: Low / Medium / High
- Data, migration, authentication, affiliate, privacy, or safety impact:
- Rollback trigger and method:

## Verification

- [ ] Required CI checks pass
- [ ] Documentation reflects the implemented state
- [ ] No production secret or production data was used in CI
- [ ] Migration is expand/contract and backward compatible, or not applicable
- [ ] Protected Help and commercial/safety separation remain intact

## Release

- [ ] Preview reviewed
- [ ] Production smoke plan confirmed
- [ ] Post-release owner identified
